'''Chai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was married to the man [[Bern]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Chai's sister, the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Bant'ena Fhernan]], was captured by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the Confederacy forced Fhernan to work for them by claiming that they would [[Death/Legends|kill]] Chai and Fherman's other family members if she refused to co-operate with them. The CIS put Chai and Bern under surveillance and a Confederacy [[Cam droid/Legends|droidcam]] recorded footage of Chai, Bern and their sons disembarking from a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] while on their way to their annual camping vacation.
